versions.changelog:
- Renamed the skill to "science-content-ppt" with an updated and more descriptive summary in SKILL.md.
- Major revamp of template structure: added comprehensive PPT and Animation template sets under "assets/templates/", with detailed categorization and usage documentation.
- Removed outdated reference and template files from previous "templates/" and "references/" folders; all templates now reside within the assets directory.
- Vastly expanded template options (20+ PPT templates and 10+ animation/flowchart templates) to cover more scenarios and use cases.
- Improved workflow description: now distinguishes clearly between default PPT animation mode and flowchart visualization mode, with explicit user guidance and AI prompt requirements.
- Included robust animation reset mechanism and stricter output requirements to ensure reliable video/demo presentation quality.

Version 1.0.1

- Added LICENSE file to the project.

AI-Animation 1.0.0 — 初始发布

- 全新自动化流程：将科普类文本一键转为炫酷 HTML 动画演示。
- 三步分明：生成基础 HTML、PPT 风格重构、可选流程图重构（RNN 风格）。
- 内置丰富模板：包含多套 PPT 与流程图视觉模板，无需额外下载。
- 输出路径灵活：支持用户自定义输出位置，默认输出到桌面。
- 强制美化动画和图标：自动转换 emoji 为平面 UI 图标，提升专业感。
- 详细操作指南与实战案例，快速上手。
